summaries.zh: A client plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that adds chat content width tiers with a floating picker button (bottom-right, above the composer): 标准 / 中等 / 宽 / 超宽 / 全宽 (standard / medium / wide / ultra / full).
summaries.en: A client plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that adds chat content width tiers with a floating picker button (bottom-right, above the composer): 标准 / 中等 / 宽 / 超宽 / 全宽 (standard / medium / wide / ultra / full).
